subject: New Gym in Paris Helps Homeless Folks Improve Their Health And Habits–Without Leaving the Shelter
posts:
A Finnish fitness company installs an outdoor gym at a Paris homeless shelter to boost resident well-being.
Evidence: 80% health improvement, 90% social connection
#GoodNews #Paris #Health

Omnigym installs outdoor fitness equipment at a Paris homeless shelter to make exercise accessible and improve marginalized health.

The initiative successfully improves physical health for 80% of respondents and fosters positive behavioral and social changes.

Simple, dignified interventions can dramatically improve mental well-being and social connection for vulnerable populations.
